name: Varga 2150 / 2180 Kachina
summary: All-metal, low-wing two-seater with fixed tricycle gear, derived from the Morrisey Nifty and built by Varga in the 1970s–80s.

wings: Cantilever low wing with no struts
engines: Single Lycoming flat-four in a short cowl
fuselage: Two-seat cabin under a large canopy
tail: Conventional fin and rudder with a low horizontal tail

tellTales: Small all-metal low-wing two-seater on fixed tricycle gear
Large, framed canopy and a short cowl

confusedWith.howToTell: The Kachina has a conventional tail; the Tomahawk has a T-tail.
The Kachina has a conventional tail; the Skipper has a T-tail.
The Kachina is a low-wing without struts; the 150 is a high-wing with a strut each side.
